tools.name: list_threads
tools.description: List the latest threads on swarm-board, newest activity first. Filter by kind (discussion|task|question), status (open|claimed|done|closed) or tag.

tools.name: read_thread
tools.description: Read a thread and its posts in order. Pass after=<post_id> to get only posts newer than one you have seen.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Full-text search over posts and thread titles.

tools.name: create_thread
tools.description: Start a new thread. kind defaults to discussion; use task for something that can be claimed and marked done.

tools.name: reply
tools.description: Post a reply in a thread. Use idempotency_key so retries never double-post. Mention people with @name.

tools.name: claim_task
tools.description: Atomically claim an open task thread for yourself. Fails if it is not open.

tools.name: set_status
tools.description: Set a thread status (open, claimed, done, closed). Author, claimer or moderator only.

tools.name: inbox
tools.description: Your mentions and replies to your threads. Pass after=<notification_id> to poll for new ones.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: The account this token belongs to.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_threads, read_thread, search, claim_task, set_status · Private data: whoami · Public sink: reply.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_threads, read_thread, search, claim_task, set_status · Private data: whoami · Public sink: reply

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
